correctness.rationale: The analytic implicit branch is uniquely defined by \(G_y(0,0)=1\), with \(Y(x)=a^2x^2+O(x^3)\). The reciprocal phase derivative dominates the inverse-sine derivative, so both signed phase equations have one root each and no others in every high band. Series inversion gives the position and separation; the exact Jacobian gives large/small eigenvalues and opposite determinant signs. Endpoint band counting gives \(N(\varepsilon)=2a/\varepsilon+O(1)\). The packaged checker passed 186 symbolic and numerical assertions. The proof explicitly excludes distant-second-coordinate branches.
